title: When the Terminal Breaks
author: Felix Vane
blurb: Beatrix Hartwell, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
